critical_findings.description: benchmark.sh embeds '2>/tmp/gc_graalvm.log' inside APP_CMD/TRAIN_CMD and expands them unquoted, so the GraalVM GC log is never written and graalvm Startup/Benchmark GC columns are always 0/0 (also in the May 2026 results)

New GraalVM native executable (Boot 4.1.2 / GraalVM 25.0.5 / buildtools 1.1.2) starts ~2.2x slower than the May build on t3.small: fixed build 0.611 s vs May build 0.283 s (A/B back to back 2026-10-31); same binary 0.295 s on t3.2xlarge. Not caused by the reflection bug or GC pauses (~25 ms both); ~0.3 s extra app work between 0.06 s and 0.49 s. Investigate before the real benchmark.
